summary: First full round of backend + frontend testing for the Twins Graduation photography booking app. Backend: created pytest suite (48 tests) covering auth/cookies/roles, public booking, booking CRUD & filters, payments (add/delete + auto status), invoice data & PDF, invoice send (mock notification), schedule + conflict detection, client portal (photos/select/submit/invoice), dashboard, finance, expenses, analytics, notifications, users. 47/48 passed. Frontend: Playwright tested owner login, dashboard stat cards & lists, all nav routes, theme toggle, public booking form end-to-end (invoice + portal link), schedule month/week/day + prev/next + conflict markers, bookings search/status filter + new-booking dialog + row navigation, booking detail (payment -> totals/badge update, invoice preview/download PDF/send, photographer/status/editing/delivery selects, drive link + admin notes persistence, add photos), client portal (details, payment progress, invoice PDF, selection counter toggle, final submission + lock, invalid token error), finance presets/chart/recent payments, expenses add/delete + total update, analytics (charts, packages, photographers, locations, repeat clients), notifications run-checks, users list + create photographer + login as new user, role-based access for admin & photographer, mobile viewport, light mode.

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout is keyed on request.client.host (ingress pod IP). Through the public URL requests rotate between proxy IPs (10.231.129.137/138), so 8 consecutive wrong passwords never trigger 429 (works only when hitting localhost:8001 directly). Also, keying on proxy IP means one attacker can lock out legitimate users behind the same IP. Use X-Forwarded-For (first hop) and/or key by email only.
No pagination (to_list(5000)); list will degrade as bookings grow. Low priority for MVP.

ui_bugs.issue: Photographer opening /admin (index route) gets a permanently BLANK page: Protected roles=['owner','admin'] redirects to '/admin', which is the same route -> redirect loop, empty content area (also happens for /admin/notifikasi). Should redirect non-owner/admin roles to /admin/jadwal.
Large IDR values overflow/are clipped inside the stat card (e.g. 'Rp 16.000.000', 'Rp 31.000.000' run past the card edge). Needs smaller font / truncation / wrap at <=400px.
Desktop aside and mobile drawer are both rendered, so every nav data-testid exists twice in the DOM (Playwright strict-mode violation). Render one, or suffix testids (nav-x-desktop / nav-x-mobile).

integration_issues.issue: Submit uses native window.confirm(); any environment that auto-dismisses dialogs (and automated tests) silently aborts with no feedback. Functionally works when confirmed, but should use the shadcn AlertDialog for consistency + testability.
When the drive_link is missing/invalid the iframe renders a raw Google 404/500 error page inside the card (seeded Andini link shows Google 500). Add link validation + graceful fallback message.

issues: Uses browser-default native date/time pickers (input type=date/time) instead of the shadcn calendar/time components used on the public form (inconsistent look in dark mode)
'Paket' is a free-text input in the admin dialog while the public form uses a package Select - typos will break package analytics
Payment summary values had no data-testid (added summary-total/dp/paid/remaining during testing)
Sticky header/hamburger scrolls out of view; toast overlaps the header user block on desktop (1920px) right after login

action_items: Fix photographer blank page at /admin: redirect roles without dashboard access to /admin/jadwal instead of /admin (redirect loop).
Fix login rate limiting to use X-Forwarded-For / email-based key so lockout works behind the ingress (currently no lockout via public URL).
Fix mobile stat card overflow for large IDR amounts.
Replace window.confirm in ClientPortal submit with shadcn AlertDialog; add fallback UI when Drive embed link is invalid.
Consider shadcn date/time pickers and a package Select in the admin Booking Baru dialog; de-duplicate sidebar nav data-testids.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js Protected(): `<Navigate to='/admin'>` for a role that is itself blocked from /admin index creates a self-redirect loop; compute a role-aware home path.
auth.py login(): identifier = f"{request.client.host}:{email}" is unreliable behind a proxy and allows collateral lockout of users sharing a proxy IP.
ops.py finance_summary/analytics/dashboard_stats load whole collections into memory (to_list(50000)) and aggregate in Python; move to MongoDB aggregation pipelines before data grows.
backend/.env defines CORS_ORIGINS but server.py ignores it and uses FRONTEND_URL - remove the dead key to avoid confusion.
Backend test files live under /app/backend/tests, which triggers uvicorn --reload on every test edit; harmless in preview but noisy in logs.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows pass; 1 HIGH routing bug for photographer /admin)

rca_of_the_issue: Photographer blank page: in App.js the /admin index route is wrapped in Protected roles=['owner','admin'] whose fallback is <Navigate to='/admin'>, i.e. the same URL, so React Router keeps rendering the blocked route and shows an empty outlet (backend correctly returns 403 for /api/dashboard/stats). Login lockout: auth.py keys login_attempts by request.client.host, which behind the k8s ingress is a rotating proxy pod IP, so the counter never reaches 5 for a single key when traffic is spread across pods.
